name: Mighty
source:
Main character arrives to a huge space station on his small space ship and is warmly greeted by five female member crew. But the peace of the station gets disturbed by a tentacle monster attack.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公驾驶小型飞船抵达一座巨型空间站，受到5名女性船员的热情欢迎。然而，触手怪物的袭击打破了空间站的和平。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
